text:
The issue "preserve newlines" in `rich` was addressed by modifying the `print` method in `rich/console.py`. Specifically, when soft wrapping is enabled, the default value for `no_wrap` (which disables word wrapping) was changed from `True` to `False` if it was `None`. This ensures that newlines within the content are preserved during soft wrapping operations.

The patch has been submitted.
